marketing.meta_title: Temas: the letting workspace for rental agents
marketing.meta_description: Viewings that book themselves, one inbox with a first draft, and applicants that keep moving. Built for independent agents and small rental agencies.

hero.eyebrow: For independent agents and small rental agencies
hero.title: Less chasing. More letting.
hero.description: Temas books viewings around everyone’s availability, drafts your replies and keeps each applicant moving, so the day goes to people instead of tabs.

intro.lead: Property software is good at keeping records. It is not good at moving a letting forward.
intro.body_1: The real work still happens in your inbox, on your phone and in your head: finding a time the tenant can do, answering the same five questions, remembering what you promised the prospect on Tuesday.
intro.body_2: Temas is a workspace for rental agents that acts on what you already have. It finds the viewing time that suits everyone, writes the first draft of the reply, reads each thread for what you said you would do, and keeps every household moving until the keys change hands.

trio.title: Everything a letting needs, in one place.
trio.viewings_body: Share one link. Prospects see only the times when you and the current tenant are both free.
trio.inbox_title: One inbox, with a first draft
trio.inbox_body: Gmail and WhatsApp in one list, matched to the right property, with a reply drafted in your tone.
trio.pipeline_body: Every form lands in a pipeline. Shortlist, then show the owner a clean side-by-side to approve.

calendar.title: The time that works for everyone.
calendar.body: Add your hours once and invite the current tenant to add theirs. Temas finds the overlap, fits the viewing length and a buffer, and publishes only those slots. The prospect picks one and confirms with an email code.
calendar.point_2: Reschedule or cancel from either side
calendar.point_3: Add the owner when they need to be there

ask.title: Ask your portfolio, not a spreadsheet.
ask.body: Questions run across your listings, calendar, pipeline and your own inbox. Answers come back with the records linked, so one click opens the property.
ask.question: Which properties are missing a deposit?

tasks.title: The promise you made at 6pm is still on the list.
tasks.body: Temas reads each thread for a specific thing you said you would do and suggests it as a task. Suggestions from your inbox are only yours. When a later message shows it is done, the task ticks itself off.
tasks.message: Could the bedroom get blackout curtains before we move in?
tasks.reply: Good question. I’ll ask the owner and come back to you.
tasks.task: Ask the owner about blackout curtains for the bedroom, then update the prospect.

contracts.title: A first draft of the lease, from facts you already entered.
contracts.body: Pick a template (mandate, offer, lease, deposit, handover or vacate). Parties, rent and listing facts fill themselves in. You edit, then export to DOCX or PDF.
contracts.note: Drafts are a starting point, not legal advice.

privacy.title: Your inbox stays yours.
privacy.body: Temas is built for small teams that share a portfolio, not their mail.
privacy.private_body: Your connected Gmail and WhatsApp are visible only to you. Not a colleague, not the workspace owner.
privacy.readonly_body: Temas drafts and answers. It never books, cancels or sends a message on its own.
privacy.scoped_body: Tenants and owners sign in with a magic link and see only their own property.
privacy.eu_body: Your workspace data lives in an EU region.
